name: Armor of the Dammed
description: (Tag:curse)(Tag:curse+)(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)Pitch-black armor with a demonic visage worn by the most wicked conquerors that augments physical abilities and amplifies darkness-based abilities when used as a focus. With training, it can unleash massive-scale curses like slow, misfortune, and weakness to debilitate entire armies.
